verdict.rationale: Operating a managed search service through natural language is a fair axis for a SaaS product, but the pack has no evidence that turbopuffer ships a natural-language command interface, chat assistant, or MCP server. What it does document is adjacent: llms.txt, an OpenAPI spec, SDKs, and native embedding of query text. These are developer building blocks or semantic-search features, not natural-language operation of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
